help.p:vale-twelve: The tray shows a number as rows and columns. The gate asks for twelve as a product — any true product opens it. Type numbers; Enter commits.
help.p:vale-machine: Feed the stone a number for x and both carvings compute in front of you. Read what the factors become. The door asks what you saw.
help.p:vale-pair: Two carved rules part ways here. Walk the way you believe; the stones along it answer. The assay stones test any claim at three numbers.
help.p:vale-braid: The ways part where the working parts. Carry your pair through the gate that re-adds the middles; take either lane; what the groups share opens the way.
help.p:vale-zero: Twelve can be made many ways; zero cannot. The last doors only open for numbers that truly land the whole line on nothing.
